title: TelephoneNumber

Id.description: Product: QBW Description: Unique identifier for an Intuit entity.

DeviceType.description: Product: ALL Description: Phone device type. Valid values are LandLine, Mobile, Fax, and Pager, as defined in the TelephoneDevice.

CountryCode.description: Product: ALL Description: Telephone country code.

AreaCode.description: Product: ALL Description: Telephone area code.

ExchangeCode.description: Product: ALL Description: Telephone exchange code.

Extension.description: Product: ALL Description: Telephone extension code.

FreeFormNumber.description: Product: ALL Description: Specifies the telephone number in free form. FreeFormNumber takes precedence over CountryCode, AreaCode, ExchangeCode, and Extension.[br /]Max length: 21 characters.

Default.description: Product: ALL Description: True if this is the default telephone number.

Tag.description: Product: ALL Description: Descriptive tag (or label) associated with the telephone number. Valid values are Business, Fax, Home, Mobile, Pager, Primary, Secondary, and Other, as defined in the TelephoneNumberLabelType.

description: Product: ALL Description: Telephone number type definition. This entity is always manipulated in the context of another parent entity like Person, Organization etc.
